description: Fiscal stress institutional fragmentation and declining trust turn manageable risks into systemic crisis.
Climate shocks interact with inequality housing stress and fragmented governance.
Formal systems lag while informal networks provide housing transit labor and services.
Speculative real estate and platform capital intensify displacement inequality and public value leakage.
Digital systems expand but public oversight privacy interoperability and democratic accountability lag.
Regional coordination links housing transit watersheds energy food systems and climate resilience.
Preventive repair lifecycle budgeting and resilience investment reduce cascade-failure risk.
Public investment housing stability climate adaptation and accountable digital systems strengthen urban capacity.
